articles.title: “You’re just on your period”: Caleb Williams’ hamstring injury sparks meme fest with “I chipped my nail polish” joke
articles.summary: NFL News: For the second time this year, Madden 27 cover athlete Caleb Williams has fallen victim to an AI-generated hoax. First, fake images of him posing in a.
articles.body: For the second time this year, Madden 27 cover athlete Caleb Williams has fallen victim to an AI-generated hoax. First, fake images of him posing in a 2026 NFL rivalry jersey circulated. And now, a fabricated video of his Week 2 hamstring injury is circulating online.In the AI-generated clip, Williams falls to the ground with the football still in his hand and starts crying inconsolably.As the team’s medical staff members gather around him, he holds up his colorfully painted nails and says, “I chipped my nail polish.” One medical staff member hands him a menstrual pad, saying, “I think you’re just on your period, you little b*tch.” Then the member puts the pad over his painted nails.The other medical staff members burst into laughter as Williams stares in shock at his injured hand. Another member lets out, “F*ck this guy,” in reaction. This clip is a textbook definition of a malicious AI-generated video.Caleb Williams put on a corny show for hamstring injuryJust because Caleb Williams reacted a certain way after his hamstring injury doesn’t mean it’s an open invitation to bring up his painted nails and supposed exaggerated reaction. But here we are!Hater Report shared Williams’ 27-second AI video on X with the caption: “THIS is the content I come to this app for lmaoo. I’M CRYING [two uncontrollably laughing emojis].” A user quickly commented, “I get he put on a corny show for just pulling a hammy, but this is just unfunny.”BrickCenter shared a 24-second video of the Chicago Bears quarterback, showcasing a compilation of his reactions to a hamstring injury. He tried to get up after falling but couldn’t, so he rolled onto the floor and lay there on his back.Later, as they carted him off the field, he covered his face with a towel. But he eventually removed it and gave the crowd a thumbs-up.BrickCenter captioned the video: “Caleb Williams did ALL THIS for a minor hamstring injury.”How painful is a minor hamstring injury?According to PlayerScout, a Grade 1 hamstring injury causes mild pain. It results from the overstretching of muscles or tendons.You may feel a slight ache or pull in the back of your thigh. The pain might not appear until you stop playing football, and the player may not even remember when the injury occurred.In most cases, you do not lose flexibility or muscle strength. However, you may feel increased tightness throughout the muscle when stretching.You may feel pain when sitting on the injured area or walking up and down stairs. Swelling is minimal or absent in a Grade 1 hamstring injury.The injury might not affect a player’s walking pattern, though they may feel slight discomfort during weight-bearing activities.Now, a reinjury makes all the difference. Reinjuring the same hamstring muscle changes the recovery entirely, as it can be much more painful than the first occurrence and provoke a stronger physical or emotional reaction.Caleb Williams suffered a reinjury of his left hamstringNFL insider Adam Schefter reported via X that Caleb Williams injured the same left hamstring against Utah in December 2022.He injured his left hamstring on a 59-yard run during the Pac-12 championship game against Utah. He did not leave the game and played in the Cotton Bowl the following week.After the Chicago Bears’ 3-9 loss to the Minnesota Vikings, he was seen walking through the locker room under his own power while the reporters were present.The Bears quarterback did not have a wrap around his leg. Head coach Ben Johnson said he could miss some time. Williams is expected to be week-to-week. He is unlikely to practice.The MRI revealed it was a Grade 1 hamstring injury. He dodged a major bullet and a long-term tear. But doesn’t a reinjury justify his reaction?Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Adam Vinatieri sets Guinness World Record for highest field goal at over 11,000 feet above sea level
articles.summary: Vinatieri's trip to the Swiss Alps was part of promoting the Patriots' November game in Munich, Germany.
articles.body:
Adam Vinatieri isn't a stranger to kicking in snowy conditions. But in the Swiss Alps? That was a first for the Hall of Fame kicker this week as he set a Guinness World Record .

On Tuesday, the 53-year-old Vinatieri set the record for kicking the highest field goal in the world at 11,332 feet above sea level at Jungfraujoch, also known as the "Top of Europe."

The conditions were a little more difficult than what he experienced at Foxboro Stadium during the 2001 AFC Divisional Playoff Game against the Oakland Raiders when he kicked a 45-yard field goal to send the New England Patriots to the AFC Championship Game.

"Snow is simply part of my time with the Patriots," Vinatieri said in a team release. "But kicking a field goal at 3,454 meters is something completely different from anything I've ever seen in the NFL. You feel the altitude with every breath you take, your heart rate is different, your rhythm is different, and no one can really tell you beforehand how it will affect the kick, because no one has done this before. The fact that we were able to set the record under these conditions makes me very proud. This is definitely one of the most special field goals I've ever made."

The record attempt was part of the Patriots' promotion for their Nov. 15 game in Munich, Germany, against the Detroit Lions . The team holds market rights in the DACH region of Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

Vinatieri played 24 NFL seasons with the Patriots and Indianapolis Colts . He is the NFL's all-time leading scorer (2,673 points) and is the league record holder for field goals made (599), playoff points (238) and successful overtime field goals (12).

A three-time First-team All-Pro, Vinatieri won three Super Bowls with the Patriots and one more with the Colts. In Super Bowls XXXVI and XXXVIII, it was his foot that kicked the Patriots to championships in the final seconds. His on-field success led to him be part of the Pro Football Hall of Fame's Class of 2026 .

articles.title: The Falcons' quarterback plan has become a four-alarm fire
articles.summary: Michael Penix Jr. gets another chance to make sense of Atlanta's increasingly bizarre quarterback saga — or send the franchise searching for yet another answ...
articles.body:
There's something thrilling, in a nerve-wracking sense, about seeing a poker player down to their last chip, gambling on one final hand, hoping that at long last the cards will turn in their favor. Now, you know how this usually ends — that last chip vanishes, the player's hopes and bankroll busted — but there's always hope.

We're just two weeks into the 2026 season, and the Atlanta Falcons are already down to their last chip. Where other teams are still working out the last of the preseason aches and pains, the Atlanta Falcons are on their fourth — fourth! — named quarterback, as Michael Penix Jr. will start for the team this Thursday night against Green Bay .

The Falcons embody Hemingway's famous line about how bankruptcy happens: gradually, then suddenly. We are very much in the "suddenly" phase now with Atlanta, but the "gradually" phase began back in March 2024, when Atlanta signed Kirk Cousins to a four-year, $180 million contract. For about four weeks, it seemed like the Falcons had at last found their franchise replacement for retired local legend Matt Ryan .

We should have known something was up, karmically speaking, when the Falcons were immediately accused of, and later fined $250,000 for, tampering during the Cousins signing process. And Cousins didn't even get the chance to dispel those bad vibes with his play; just weeks after finalizing that massive deal, the Falcons drafted Penix.

Not only did Atlanta fail to notify Cousins, which doesn't seem like the optimal way to begin a relationship, but the Falcons bypassed more than half a dozen future Pro Bowlers, on both sides of the ball, to select the already-often-injured Penix.

Diagnosing what happened from there — Penix and Cousins shuttling in and out of the starting job as each struggled with injury and/or ineffectiveness — is like reading a police report on the wreck that totaled your car. The Why and How don't really much matter anymore; the real question now is, what to do from here?

Another famous American philosopher, John Madden, has a notable line of his own: When you have two quarterbacks, you have none . To which the 2026 Falcons replied: Yes, but what if we have FOUR quarterbacks?

Penix has been sidelined since November of last year with a torn ACL. Atlanta signed Tua Tagovailoa on a cheap one-year prove-it deal; Tagovailoa promptly suffered an oblique injury days after being named the Week 1 starter, and still hasn't played. QB3 Cooper Rush has struggled so badly that Atlanta has exactly as many red zone possessions this year as you do. Fan favorite Jack Strand finally got the nod during Sunday's blowout loss to Carolina, and on his very first NFL play, this happened:

The last Falcon to throw a pick-6 on his first play was a guy named Brett Favre … but he wasn't a Falcon for much longer after that.

The maddening aspect of all this chaos, for long-suffering Falcons fans, is that Atlanta has all the other pieces of a playoff-quality team already in place. Swap in a Baker Mayfield or a Jalen Hurts or half a dozen other quarterbacks in the 10th-to-20th-ranked range to run an offense with Bijan Robinson , Drake London , Kyle Pitts et. al., and Atlanta instantly becomes a postseason contender. But it doesn't matter how sweet your Ferrari's interior, sound system and tires are if you've got a lawnmower engine under the hood.

And so the frustrations continue. Atlanta hasn't reached the playoffs since the 2017 season, the second-longest drought, after the Jets , in the NFL. Even in the woeful NFC South, where there's a home playoff game awaiting any team that manages to rise to the level of mediocre, Atlanta hasn't been able to break through.

The 2027 NFL Draft promises a wealth of quarterback talent, from Arch Manning to Dante Moore to whichever Fernando Mendoza-esque shooting star separates from the pack over the next 10 weeks. ('Sup, Drew Mestemaker.)

This puts the Falcons in an uncomfortable limbo: If Penix plays poorly, the Falcons can console themselves and their fans that there's potentially a better option awaiting in the draft. If Penix plays with poise, precision and — most importantly — durability that he hasn't shown yet, the Falcons might be able to salvage something from this 30-month debacle.

But what about the most likely scenario — the possibility that Penix plays well enough to win a few games, not enough to win the division but enough to push Atlanta down out of the elite-QB draft slots? Do the Falcons attempt to go for a sixth quarterback in two-plus seasons?

These are interesting times in Atlanta, the same way it's interesting to be an overmatched quarterback with an NFL-quality defensive line chasing you. No matter what happens next under center for Atlanta, starting Thursday against the Packers , it's going to be memorable … one way or another.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes leads Josh Allen in Week 2 passing yards but Nick Wright still sides with Buffalo Bills QB over Kansas City Chiefs QB
articles.summary: Josh Allen vs. Patrick Mahomes is not new. This has been going on for ages! All thanks to the close draft years.
articles.body: Josh Allen vs. Patrick Mahomes is not new. This has been going on for ages! All thanks to the close draft years. Allen entered the NFL in 2018, while Mahomes came a year earlier.But since then, the duo has seen mountains-apart success [Allen rocks regular season while Mahomes shines in postseason]. Allen ranks higher individually heading into the 2026 NFL season, but Mahomes leads as a team winner, with three Super Bowl victories in his franchise.Allen’s team has reached the Super Bowl four times but has never won. He personally has never played in the Big Game. But they say this year, the Buffalo Bills’ quarterback will finally get his Great White Buffalo. Will he or will he not? It all depends on how he performs from here on.For now, FOX Sports analyst Nick Wright ranks him No. 1, even though Patrick Mahomes led Week 2 in passing yards with 382. Let’s understand whyy [not a typo, just a curious ‘why’].Nick Wright ranks Josh Allen over Patrick Mahomes despite Chiefs QB leading Week 2 in passing yardsFirst Things First co-host Nick Wright openly declared that Patrick Mahomes is best suited alongside Matthew Stafford in tier 2 [second row of the quarterback mountain] despite being the best Week 2 performer in passing yards.“I know what everyone’s expecting - fresh off 400 yards, three touchdowns, a perfect pass rate, Patrick Mahomes to be atop the mountain. He is not,” Wright said. “Row two of the mountain, along with Matthew Stafford. Patrick is going to climb his way up to the top. I am confident in that.”Just because Mahomes was injured [now recovered] doesn’t mean he has to earn that No. 1 spot so tortoise-slowly. Even when he wholeheartedly deserves it. Anyhow, why did sports broadcaster Nick Wright place Josh Allen over him?“Josh Allen, who is arguably as good as any - not arguably,” Wright said.“There is no player, maybe in the history of the NFL, certainly in the league right now, you would rather have quarterbacking your team when it’s pumpkin spice latte season. That is Josh Allen. He is atop the mountain.”Just because Allen scored nine touchdowns in two weeks? As much as Patrick Mahomes and Peyton Manning had already done in 2018 and 2013, respectively?Allen’s peak came so late in his career…Mahomes’ peak came when he entered the season. It’s still there. Just a little scratch on it because of his never-had-before ACL/LCL injury.He has fully recovered from it. He is going to become the best on his own pace! He’s already proving every analyst - who didn’t vouch for him for 2026 - wrong! What more do they need?Josh Allen favored to win NFL MVP but there’s no Patrick Mahomes mentionCBS Sports’ Tyler Sullivan notes that Josh Allen began his 2026 season at a “scorching hot pace.” So hot that the league’s Most Valuable Player [NFL MVP] award is already tied to his name.He clocked passing and rushing yards in Week 1 against the Houston Texans and Week 2 against the Detroit Lions.Allen is the third player in NFL history with 9+ total touchdowns and zero turnovers in the first two games of a regular season, only after Patrick Mahomes [2018] and Peyton Manning [2013]. Both went on to win the NFL MVP that year. The same is projected for the Buffalo Bills quarterback.As for Patrick Mahomes’ odds? According to CBS Sports’ Tyler Sullivan, there’s no mention of Mahomes.After Josh Allen, the betting markets point to Lamar Jackson, Joe Burrow, and Caleb Williams as other quarterbacks with a shot. Don’t know how Caleb Williams still does, after his Grade 1 hamstring injury and Week 2 loss to the Minnesota Vikings.Anyhow, updated BetMGM and DraftKings predictors, as noted by The Athletic’s Katie Richcreek, rank Patrick Mahomes No. 2 for NFL MVP odds after Week 2. So it looks like a close battle between Josh Allen and Patrick Mahomes for the NFL MVP. Once again! Who will win? Only time will tell.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: New Marvin Harrison Jr. Trade Rumors on Cardinals WR Amid Struggles to Start 2026 NFL Season
articles.summary: Teams around the NFL are keeping an eye on wide receiver Marvin Harrison Jr.'s status with the Arizona Cardinals, according to ESPN's Dan Graziano.
articles.body:
Teams around the NFL are keeping an eye on wide receiver Marvin Harrison Jr.'s status with the Arizona Cardinals, according to ESPN's Dan Graziano .

Graziano reported Wednesday that "execs around the league are wondering whether the Arizona Cardinals could explore trading" Harrison.

"Harrison is extension-eligible after this season, and as of now, the Cardinals would have a hard time paying him based on what he's shown in the league so far," Graziano reported. "It's worth watching out for a potential change-of-scenery deal in this case."

Underperforming Players With the Most to Prove 🏈

Harrison, the No. 4 pick of the 2024 draft, is currently signed through the 2027 season with a 2028 club option on his rookie contract . He has made one catch for 33 yards through two games of his third NFL season.

Harrison was targeted twice in Week 2, although one target was erased due to a penalty and he made no receptions in the Cardinals' 31-7 loss to the visiting Seattle Seahawks.

Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said after Sundays's loss he didn't see Harrison's lack of production as connected to any issues with his effort level.

"The spots he was trying to get to, he was getting to, we just weren't able to connect," LaFleur said.

LaFleur continued, "I know it's like, 'Well, just get some easy completions to get going.' And that's fine. You also have Trey McBride, who's one of the best underneath guys in the world, and there's only about 60, 65 plays a game."

He added it was a "long season" and indicated he felt Harrison could see more usage in the future depending on the defensive scheme of the teams the Cardinals line up again.

McBride has gotten the largest target share among Jacoby Brissett's pass-catchers so far this season, hauling down 17 receptions on 23 targets for 136 yards and two touchdowns.

Among Cardinals receivers, most targets have gone to veteran wideout Kendrick Bourne and Michael Wilson Jr., the latter of which signed a three-year, $75 million extension with $47 million guaranteed earlier this month.

McBride signed his own extension last offseason, giving the Cardinals two long-term pass-catching options even if the franchise decides to move on from Harrison.

The Cardinals could potentially receive increase trade interest in Harrison should he see more usage ahead of the deadline. Whether the franchise will actually consider selling in November could depend on how LaFleur is able to help his team build on their 1-1 start, starting Sunday with a road game against the 2-0 San Francisco 49ers.

articles.title: Alec Pierce Injured, Latest Updates on Colts WR's Timeline for Return After Re-Aggravating Heel
articles.summary: It was already known that Indianapolis Colts wide receiver Alec Pierce would miss time after injuring the same heel he had surgery on in the offseason, but the timeline for his return is still being determined.
articles.body:
It was already known that Indianapolis Colts wide receiver Alec Pierce would miss time after injuring the same heel he had surgery on in the offseason, but the timeline for his return is still being determined.

Per ESPN's Jeremy Fowler , Pierce and the Colts are "hopeful" he will miss four to six weeks after receiving a second opinion early in the week.

The timeline remains uncertain, though, because Fowler noted it is a "complicated injury situation" and how Pierce feels each week as he goes through rehab "will be crucial" in determining how long he is out.

Colts head coach Shane Steichen announced on Wednesday that Pierce will be placed on injured reserve.

Pierce left Sunday's overtime loss to the Kansas City Chiefs in the first quarter with a heel injury. He quietly had ankle surgery in March after signing a four-year, $116 million contract to remain with the Colts in free agency.

The recovery period from the surgery extended well into the preseason. Pierce had multiple PRP injections to assist in the recovery. He was activated off the physically unable to perform list on Aug. 27, just over two weeks before their season opener.

Colts head coach Shane Steichen announced on Monday that Pierce's X-rays came back negative.

Per NFL Network's Ian Rapoport , it's "not a guarantee" Pierce will avoid having surgery, but he will attempt to rehab the injury.

An IR stint will keep Pierce out for a minimum of four games. The Colts signed veteran receiver Darius Slayton this week to provide them with pass-catching depth.

Pierce only played 32 of Indianapolis' 54 offensive snaps in Week 1 against the Baltimore Ravens. He was on the field for 17 snaps against the Chiefs prior to the injury.

The 26-year-old Pierce has been one of the best deep threats since entering the NFL in 2022. He has led the league in yards per catch in each of the past two seasons with 22.3 in 2024 and 21.3 in 2025.

Last season marked Pierce's first 1,000-yard campaign. He also finished second on the Colts with six touchdown receptions.

The Colts are off to an 0-2 start even though the offense, despite missing Pierce for most of Week 2, ranks 10th in points scored. Their defense has allowed an NFL-high 74 points.

Indianapolis is riding the NFL's longest active losing streak at nine straight games dating back to Week 12 last season. The Colts will look to snap the skid on Sunday when they host the Houston Texans.

articles.title: NFL Trade Rumor: Washington Commanders critically linked to $4M Cleveland Browns quarterback amid Jayden Daniels elbow injury
articles.summary: Deshaun Watson is shining with the Cleveland Browns, meaning they may not need Shedeur Sanders or Dillon Gabriel.
articles.body: Deshaun Watson is shining with the Cleveland Browns, meaning they may not need Shedeur Sanders or Dillon Gabriel.Just as the Arizona Cardinals may rely heavily on 2026 rookie Carson Beck to back up Jacoby Brissett, the Browns may rely on Taylen Green for Deshaun Watson.This leaves little room for Shedeur Sanders, who carries the nepotism baggage of his father - NFL legend Deion Sanders. Sanders wants the best platform to prove himself, and what better platform than the Washington Commanders? Behind someone as young as Jayden Daniels.Though Daniels’ timeline looks surprisingly closer than ever to Robert Griffin III’s, what will Regina Jackson - his mother and manager - supposedly say to this now? His repeated elbow injuries have once again pushed the Commanders’ postseason goals out of reach.Shedeur Sanders linked to Commanders amid Jayden Daniels injuryShedeur Sanders wants to prove himself; with Washington Commanders wide receiver Stefon Diggs by his side, could he become what he wants?Without the constant comparison to [almost] franchise quarterback Deshaun Watson or his 2025 rookie companion, Dillon Gabriel. Or any other that the Cleveland Browns reportedly draft every year.Marcus Mariota is there in Washington to win the games, but for how long? Could a backup become a franchise, dependable, or future quarterback?FanSided’s Wynston Wilcox suggests a trade proposal involving Shedeur Sanders and the Washington Commanders, via the Houston Texans.Listen to this: the Washington Commanders trade their 2027 fifth-round pick for Cleveland Browns QB Shedeur Sanders and a 2027 seventh-round pick via the Houston Texans.Washington needs to think about their future quarterbackAccording to Wynston Wilcox, Shedeur Sanders could be better respected in Washington than in Cleveland. “He gets a system that won’t disrespect him,” Wilcox wrote. Sanders could develop alongside 2024 draft pick Jayden Daniels. Veteran QB Marcus Mariota could fill in when needed.The Commanders may also need to think about the future…Especially if their 2024 thriller keeps getting injured every other season; one happened in 2025, and now in 2026.Daniels is trending toward Robert Griffin III, but his manager mother supposedly won’t agree… Remember her blasting tweet in October 2025 after his injury?“I wish you would stop manifesting RGIII on my son. Words are powerful, and that’s all that’s talked about,” Regina Jackson wrote on X.Well, playing presence is reportedly valued on the NFL gridiron. If the quarterback is injured, the team suffers tremendously. When the team suffers, the front office and coaching staff could be pushed to take measures.And at desperate times like this, at the start of a new season, it definitely calls for desperate measures. Who’s better at the moment than a quarterback who solely wants/yearns for a chance to prove himself?Shedeur Sanders college football statsSanders was a four-star quarterback at Trinity Christian School. He was a top-300 player in the country, a top-40 player in Texas, and a top-30 quarterback in the class of 2021.He threw for 12,448 yards and 166 touchdowns in his high school career, with 3,702 yards and 43 touchdowns during his senior year. He achieved numerous accolades and broke numerous records in college.He is someone you can depend on… All he needs is one chance! To show the world that he’s one of the best quarterbacks. Like he was in Colorado and before. He may not get that chance in Cleveland, but he could get one in Washington.Shedeur Sanders could save CommandersIt could be a win-win for Washington. Shedeur Sanders has not played a single game since this season began. He urgently needs that. He got gridiron time late last season.The same could happen this year if Deshaun Watson stays healthy and Dillon Gabriel also recovers and joins Watson as backup. Washington needs a quarterback right now. Who better than someone available right now? Sanders is sitting on the bench waiting for his turn.He recorded 1,400 passing yards, 7 touchdowns, and 10 interceptions in 2025 as a rookie.If he gets a better system at Washington, with reliable veteran pass-catchers like Stefon Diggs, he may not throw as many interceptions as he did in his rookie season. Anyhow, this trade proposal ends here.Either the Commanders can wait for a knight in shining armor to save their 2026 season, starting to smell like their 2025 campaign, or they can trade for Sanders right now! And leave everything on someone who wants to prove himself…Shedeur Sanders trade rumorsCategoryDetailsPlayer NameShedeur SandersCurrent TeamCleveland BrownsProposed DestinationWashington CommandersContract Status2026 is the second year of his 2025 contractContract ValueHe signed a four-year, $4.64 million contract, including a $447,380 signing bonus and $447,380 in guaranteed money, with an average annual income of $1.16 millionCap Hit and Dead Cap ValueIn 2026, he is scheduled to earn a $1.005 million base salary and $10,880 workout bonus while carrying a $1.12 million cap hit and a $346,415 dead cap valueYears Left On The ContractUFA [unrestricted free agent] in 2029, three years left.Career Earnings$2.3 million over 2 NFL seasons with Cleveland Browns.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Tua's Role Updated by Falcons HC After Michael Penix Jr. Gets Named QB1 vs. Packers
articles.summary: The Atlanta Falcons might have their top two quarterbacks both available for the first time this season for Thursday night's matchup at the Green Bay Packers.
articles.body:
The Atlanta Falcons might have their top two quarterbacks both available for the first time this season for Thursday night's matchup at the Green Bay Packers.

Tua Tagovailoa is "trending in the right direction" to back up Michael Penix Jr. against the Packers, head coach Kevin Stefanski told reporters Wednesday.

"He's working very, very hard to get himself back healthy, and he's doing really well there," Stefanski said about Tagovailoa.

Stefanski added Tagovailoa has been "ultra supportive, [a] great person to have around the building."

The Falcons announced Monday Penix, who sat out the first two games of the season amid his recovery from the knee injury that prematurely ended his 2025 season, would start Thursday.

Tagovailoa, who was sidelined through Week 2 with an oblique injury, returned to Falcons practice in a limited capacity Monday before he was listed as a full participant on Tuesday's injury report .

The Falcons are heading into Thursday's matchup against the Packers having gone 0-2 with Cooper Rush playing in front of backup Jack Strand.

Rush threw a pair of interceptions in both starts, most recently recording just 86 passing yards in a 34-3 blowout loss to the Carolina Panthers during last Sunday's home opener.

Penix has not played since suffering a torn ACL in Week 11 of the 2025 season. Tagovailoa last saw regular-season action in Week 15 of the same campaign before he was benched at the end of his tenure with the Miami Dolphins.

Both quarterbacks could now be challenged with taking on a Packers defense that has so far this season allowed the fifth-fewest yards against in the NFL when the Week 3 matchup kicks off Thursday at 8:15 p.m. ET at Lambeau Field.

articles.title: Urban Meyer sends Lane Kiffin a blunt message after LSU loss as troubling road record comes under fresh scrutiny
articles.summary: Urban Meyer has urged Lane Kiffin to “self-evaluate” after LSU’s 32-24 loss to Ole Miss, pointing to Kiffin’s record in true road games against AP Top 25
articles.body: Urban Meyer has urged Lane Kiffin to “self-evaluate” after LSU’s 32-24 loss to Ole Miss, pointing to Kiffin’s record in true road games against AP Top 25 teams. Meyer made the comment on The Triple Option after Kiffin’s Oxford return. LSU erased a 17-point halftime deficit but could not finish the comeback, leaving Kiffin 2-19 in those road games, according to the figure discussed on the show.Urban Meyer tells Lane Kiffin to “self-evaluate” after LSU lossMeyer’s point was not simply about the defeat at Ole Miss. The former Ohio State coach focused on Kiffin’s road record. On the Sept. 23 episode of The Triple Option, Rob Stone brought up Kiffin’s 2-19 record against AP Top 25 teams on the road, along with his 1-9 mark against AP Top 10 teams.“That’s a strong enough ratio there that … he’s got to self-evaluate what they do on the road,” Meyer said.The latest example came Sept. 19, when No. 7 LSU visited No. 8 Ole Miss. The Tigers fell behind 24-7 by halftime, then fought back with 17 straight points to tie the game at 24. LSU had a chance late, but Ole Miss quarterback Trinidad Chambliss ran for a 14-yard touchdown and then helped the Rebels complete the two-point conversion. LSU’s final drive ended when Jaylon Braxton intercepted Sam Leavitt in the end zone.The loss dropped LSU to 2-1 and gave Ole Miss a 3-0 start. Chambliss finished with 363 passing yards and two touchdown passes. The Ole Miss Athletics report confirms the final score and late interception.Lane Kiffin’s road record adds pressure after Ole Miss defeatThe road number needs some context. Kiffin has not struggled everywhere away from home, and his record against ranked teams improved after he arrived at Ole Miss. He went 1-3 against ranked opponents at Tennessee, 2-7 at USC and 0-5 at Florida Atlantic before taking the Ole Miss job.At Ole Miss, his teams went 10-10 against ranked opponents, showing that the issue was not simply playing strong teams away from Oxford. His tenure also produced wins at Auburn in 2023 and Oklahoma in 2025.Several losses help explain Meyer’s comment. Ole Miss lost at LSU in 2022 after entering Baton Rouge at 7-0 and ranked No. 7. The Rebels led 20-17 early in the fourth quarter before an interception by Jaxson Dart helped LSU change the game. The Tigers won 45-20.A year later, Ole Miss lost 24-10 at Alabama after leading 7-6 at halftime. Georgia then beat the Rebels 52-17 in Athens in 2023, despite Ole Miss entering ranked No. 9 with an 8-1 record.Kiffin is now beginning a new chapter at LSU after six seasons at Ole Miss. LSU hired him after his final Ole Miss team went 11-1 in the regular season and reached the College Football Playoff. His return to Oxford ended with a loss, but the season is only three games old.Meyer’s question is what Kiffin changes next. LSU’s next road tests will provide more evidence about whether the pattern he highlighted continues, and how he responds under pressure.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Giants QB Jaxson Dart will reportedly have knee surgery, ending his 2026 season
articles.summary: Dart suffered the injury during the Giants' opening drive in their Monday night loss to the Rams.
articles.body:
New York Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart will reportedly have knee surgery after getting hurt during Monday night's 28-6 loss to the Los Angeles Rams , according to ESPN's Ian Rapoport. While Dart is expected to make a full recovery, his 2026 season will be over.

Per ESPN's Adam Schefter, Dart's injury includes damage to his left MCL, PCL and meniscus. There is reportedly no ACL damage.

According to NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo on Tuesday, the MRI results showed that the damage was worse than expected.

Giants head coach John Harbaugh met with reporters on Tuesday afternoon and said that Dart was continuing to be evaluated and they had not made any decisions on the quarterback's status. The team "learned a lot more" about the injury following the MRI.

"It's an ongoing conversation about the health of a player, of a person," Harbaugh said. "We've got to prepare for the range of possibilities."

As for whether the injury could require season-ending surgery, Harbaugh said, "I don't think I could really comment on that right now until we know for sure what's going to transpire."

Dart suffered the injury in the first quarter and did not return to the game. X-rays were negative and the second-year signal-caller underwent an MRI on Tuesday after the team returned home from Los Angeles .

During the game's opening drive, Dart dropped back to pass and jumped to make a throw downfield while under pressure. He was sandwiched between Rams linebackers Josaiah Stewart and Byron Young before falling to the ground holding his left knee.

After being tended to on the field, Dart limped off and was taken for further evaluation. He was initially listed as questionable to return before being ruled out. He returned later without his uniform and watched the remainder of the game from the sideline.

Jameis Winston , who signed a two-year, $13-million extension before Week 1, finished the game going 11-for-27 with 111 passing yards, an interception and taking two sacks.

Jaxson Dart among Giants' MNF injury concerns

Dart wasn't the only injured Giant coming out of Monday night.

Wide receiver Malik Nabers injured his right shoulder in the first quarter. Nabers told reporters afterward that the shoulder popped out and he popped it back in, allowing him to return to the game the next series.

Linebacker Brian Burns had his left ankle rolled on by a Rams offensive lineman and needed help getting off the field. He limped his way to the Giants' locker room and was diagnosed with a low ankle sprain. He reportedly wore a boot on his left foot and while he said it's " nothing serious ," it's unclear if Burns will miss any time.

Left tackle Andrew Thomas suffered a groin injury on the team's final offensive play, but no update has been provided on his status.

The Giants entered the game without cornerbacks Deonte Banks and Paulson Adebo , who were ruled out due to injury.

The Giants' next two games are at home against the Tennessee Titans and Arizona Cardinals . They will go back on the road for Week 5 to face the Washington Commanders and return home for Week 6 against the New Orleans Saints . They will then travel to take on the Houston Texans before their bye in Week 8.

articles.title: Jaxson Dart Out For Season With Knee Injury, Latest NFL Rumors on Giants QB's Timeline to Return
articles.summary: New York Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart will reportedly undergo season-ending knee surgery, according to NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo.
articles.body:
New York Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart will reportedly undergo season-ending knee surgery, according to NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo .

ESPN's Adam Schefter reported the second-year star "suffered damage to his MCL, PCL and meniscus." The Giants expect Dart "to make a full recovery and be ready for the 2027 season, sources told Rapoport," per ESPN's Jordan Raanan .

Fans were a little encouraged when they saw Dart return to the sidelines — in street clothes — during New York's 28-6 loss to the Los Angeles Rams in Week 2. He reportedly lobbied to get back into the game, too.

Two days later, however, the severity of Dart's injury became clear .

It's hard to overstate how bad this is for the Giants in the short and long terms.

Backup quarterback Jameis Winston struggled mightily against the Rams, finishing 11-of-27 for 11 yards and an interception. They're now facing the prospect of making Winston the starter and promoting Jake Haener from their practice squad.

Looking beyond 2026, Dart is a franchise QB who will have made 16 appearances through his first two years. That's not ideal any way you cut it, especially when the 2025 first-round pick was considered a project who needed time to develop in the pros.

Assuming he's healthy, Dart will be the Giants' QB1 to open next season. But a major knee injury is a clear setback to him making the improvements necessary to evolve into a top-tier quarterback.

New York will also have a smaller sample from which to judge his value when it comes time to consider an extension.

articles.title: Deshaun Watson Says He Doesn't Want to Feud With Browns Fans in Video Ahead of Home Opener
articles.summary: Deshaun Watson got into it with Cleveland Browns fans before the season started, but he's hoping to be on good terms with the fanbase as the team plays its first home game of the season.
articles.body:
Deshaun Watson got into it with Cleveland Browns fans before the season started, but he's hoping to be on good terms with the fanbase as the team plays its first home game of the season.

"I never try to go at war with the fans, and the biggest thing is, just ready for support, ready to feel that energy, ready to get this big dub for the city of Cleveland and continue this great feeling we have this week," Watson told reporters on Wednesday. "That's my motto."

Watson received boos from Browns fans during a preseason game last month, and he called out fans for being "disrespctful" afterwards.

"I think the whole world knows it has nothing to do about the performance," Watson said after the game . "It's a little bit [more] personal than that. So I think it's a disrespectful thing. So yeah, I mean, I'm going to keep whatever I feel with me and my family internally on how I feel about that. And yeah, just move on."

Watson perhaps made up for his comments with a strong performance in a win over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday. The veteran quarterback threw for 238 yards and two touchdowns in the win.

Having a big showing in Cleveland's home opener would only help Watson win the fans back more.

articles.title: Marvin Harrison Jr., with just one catch this season, continues to see his stock plummet
articles.summary: A video of Marvin Harrison Jr.'s bad routes in Week 2 got a lot of attention.
articles.body:
There are 220 players with two or more catches this season. Among them: Nate Adkins , Jared Wayne , LaJohntay Wester , Brady Russell , Brevyn Spann-Ford and Lan Larison .

One notable player not on that list of 220: Marvin Harrison Jr.

It's early in the season but there is already a lot of worry about Harrison. It's not just two games. It's 31 underwhelming games into his career for the Arizona Cardinals receiver. He has just two 100-yard games. He has one game with more than six catches. And two games into this season he has one catch for 33 yards. The Cardinals threw it 28 times in Week 2 against the Seahawks and Harrison was targeted only once.

Harrison was one of the most exciting receiver prospects ever. He was the fourth overall pick of the 2024 NFL Draft, after three really good quarterbacks ( Caleb Williams , Jayden Daniels , Drake Maye ) were picked. Nobody is excited anymore.

A report from Dan Graziano of ESPN said some executives are wondering if the Cardinals could trade Harrison before the deadline this season. The problem might be finding a team that is willing to give up anything of value to get him. Given the buzz around Harrison a little more than two years ago, that's startling.

The tide has been turning on Harrison, and a video that went viral this week is going to further paint the picture of a player who is never going to live up to the hype that surrounded him when he entered the NFL.

The video posted by @RookieWatxh shows Harrison's routes from Week 2 against Seattle . Harrison looks checked out. There is no crispness or explosion within the routes. The video was viewed by 1.7 million people on X as of Wednesday morning.

That's not a good look, and it's no wonder why he only got one target against the Seahawks. Targets are earned, and he didn't do enough to get open.

Cardinals coach Mike LaFleur defended Harrison when he spoke to the media on Monday.

"I think his running style is different than some other people's, I'd say that," LaFleur said. "If that's people's narrative on him that's fine, but I know his teammates don't feel that way."

Perhaps that's true. But Harrison's role in the offense and his production, or lack thereof, is undeniable.

Will Cardinals get Harrison more involved?

When LaFleur was asked about getting Harrison involved more, he didn't seem too excited about the idea.

"It's like, well just get some easy completions to get going," LaFleur told the media on Monday . "That's fine. You also have Trey McBride , who's one of the best undernearth guys in the world, and there's only about 60, 65 plays a game. And you have to run the ball, and you have Kendrick [Bourne] who works underneath pretty well too, so everyone kind of has their role right there."

It's a fair assessment. After what we've seen from Harrison, why would the Cardinals go out of their way to get him more involved?

There have been a few moments of promise for Harrison, and he hasn't been horrendous (608 yards in 12 games last season). But he has not been anywhere near a reliable No. 1 receiver. Maybe not even a great No. 2 receiver. When Michael Wilson filled in for an injured Harrison last season, in his first three games he had at least 10 catches and 118 yards in each of them. Harrison has never had 10 catches in a game and 118 yards only once in three seasons.

When Harrison was getting ready for the draft, he did not work out at the combine and did not work out for teams. He let his impressive college tape at Ohio State speak for itself. In retrospect, seeing the lack of explosiveness from Harrison in the NFL, maybe he knew he wouldn't test well and it would affect his draft stock. He doesn't play like someone who would have run a 4.3 40-yard dash at the combine.

It's not over for Harrison for this season or his career. There's a reason he was such a highly coveted draft prospect. He was excellent at Ohio State. He's just 24 years old and 31 games isn't enough for every player to show what he'll be in the NFL. Two games, which includes one against a stellar Seahawks defense, doesn't provide a definitive answer for what Harrison's role will be.

It just doesn't look good so far this season. LaFleur is part of a new staff that didn't have anything to do with drafting Harrison. They don't seem particularly interested in increasing his usage, nor has Harrison earned a bigger share.

Maybe some team will trade for Harrison this season. Maybe it won't make a difference.

articles.title: Antonio Brown avoids 30-year prison sentence for attempted murder by accepting 'an offer he couldn't refuse'
articles.summary: Antonio Brown's Miami-Dade plea deal drops the second-degree murder charge and Brown will be on probation after the victim said he forgave him.
articles.body: Former NFL star Antonio Brown accepted "an offer he couldn't refuse" plea deal Wednesday from Miami-Dade County prosecutors and he will no longer face a second-degree murder charge nor the possible 30-year prison sentence it carries, according to his attorney. Brown's attorney, Mark Eiglarsh, said in a statement the plea deal offered by prosecutors will "dramatically reduce the criminal charge against him and result in probation rather than a prison sentence." Brown was facing a minimum 20-year sentence that could have topped out at 30 years, depending on sentencing, if convicted on initial charges stemming from a May 16, 2025 shooting outside a celebrity boxing event in Miami’s Little Haiti neighborhood. TIGER WOODS STRIKES PLEA DEAL IN FLORIDA ROLLOVER CRASH CASE, LOSES DRIVER'S LICENSE FOR 5 YEARS Prosecutors alleged Brown fought with Zul-Qarnain Kwame Nantambu, took a gun from a security guard and fired two shots while pursuing him. Nantambu told investigators that one bullet grazed his neck. Brown left the country. But he was arrested on charges related to the case by U.S. Marshals in Dubai in November 2025, extradited back to Florida, and eventually pleaded not guilty. He was released on $25,000 bond and forced to wear a GPS monitor. Brown pleaded not guilty to the charges. Eiglarsh maintained Brown acted in self-defense and pursued dismissal under Florida’s "stand your ground" law. ANTONIO BROWN HEADS TO THE FOOD TRUCK AFTER GETTING OUT OF JAIL The plea agreement the prosecution offered no doubt has something to do with the fact Nantambu’s attorney said this month that his client had forgiven Brown and no longer wanted to participate in the prosecution. And while prosecutors could have conceivably decided to move forward with their case, using video and other witness accounts, that obviously was not the path they chose. "He is not accepting this agreement because he suddenly agrees with the State's allegations," Eiglarsh said. "He is accepting it because the State made him an offer he couldn't refuse. "There is a profound difference between believing you can win a case and deciding that you and your family cannot afford to spend another year, or potentially several years, wearing an ankle monitor and fighting it." articles.title: Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart to undergo season-ending knee surgery, reports say
articles.summary: New York Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart will miss the rest of the season after injuring multiple ligaments in his left knee, according to multiple reports.
articles.body: New York Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart will miss the rest of the season after injuring multiple ligaments in his left knee, according to multiple reports. Dart is expected to undergo surgery after damaging his meniscus, MCL and PCL, according to ESPN’s Adam Schefter. The second-year quarterback sustained the injury in the first quarter of the Giants’ 28-6 loss to the Los Angeles Rams on Monday. Dart was attempting a pass on third-and-8 when he was sandwiched between multiple defenders, and a Rams linebacker collided with his left knee. Dart, 23, was the 25th overall pick in the 2025 NFL Draft. He began his rookie season as a backup to Russell Wilson, but became New York’s starter after an 0-3 start to the season. In 14 games and 12 starts, Dart completed 63.7% of his passes for 2,272 yards during his rookie season, throwing 15 touchdowns and five interceptions. He also ran for 487 yards and nine scores. Dart’s aggressive style of play has been a concern at times, however. He missed two games during his first year because of a concussion and was subjected to several other concussion checks throughout the season. In his first game back after the head injury, Dart was running when he was subject to a big hit in a game against the New England Patriots. “No, look, I understand the question, but this is football,” Dart said last December when asked if he would change his style of play to be more conservative. “I’m going to get hit if I’m in the pocket or outside the pocket. I feel like I played this way my whole entire life. It shouldn’t be any shocker to anybody if you followed along with my career. He added: “We’re not playing soccer out here. You’re going to get hit. Things happen. It’s just part of the game.” Veteran Jameis Winston, the No. 1 overall pick in 2015, played in relief of Dart in the loss to Los Angeles. In three games last season, Winston completed 56.1% of his passes for 567 yards, two touchdowns and two interceptions. Outside of Winston, the Giants have no other quarterbacks on their depth chart. Former fourth-round pick Jake Haener, who made his only career start in 2024, is on the team’s practice squad. New York’s next game is at home against the 0-2 Tennessee Titans.

articles.title: Lamar Jackson Gives Funny Quote on Fan Expectations for Ravens vs. Cowboys in Brazil
articles.summary: Ahead of Sunday's NFL Rio Game against the Dallas Cowboys, Baltimore Ravens star quarterback Lamar Jackson isn't concerned about fans in Brazil rooting for his opponents.
articles.body:
Ahead of Sunday's NFL Rio Game against the Dallas Cowboys, Baltimore Ravens star quarterback Lamar Jackson isn't concerned about fans in Brazil rooting for his opponents.

When Ravens reporter Jerry Coleman asked Jackson about the Cowboys potentially having the fans on their side due to their status as "America's team," the two-time NFL MVP brushed it off with a funny response.

"This is America, that's Brazil, so we'll see. We'll see," Jackson said with a smile.

This will mark the Ravens' first trip overseas since their victory over the Tennessee Titans at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium in London in Oct. 2023.

The Cowboys will be the designated home team in Sunday's matchup at Maracanã Stadium in Rio De Janeiro, but it sounds like Jackson is expecting to win fans over as the Ravens try to bounce back from their Week 2 loss to the New Orleans Saints.

articles.title: Chris Johnson opens up about his heartbreaking ALS journey as former NFL star fights for more time with his wife and children
articles.summary: Chris Johnson’s ALS diagnosis has changed much of his life, but the former NFL star says it has not changed who he is.
articles.body: Chris Johnson’s ALS diagnosis has changed much of his life, but the former NFL star says it has not changed who he is. Diagnosed in May 2025 at 39, Johnson revealed the news publicly in June 2026. By September, ALS had taken away his ability to speak, while an eye-controlled device now helps him communicate. His wife, Brittany, is now his main caregiver as the family adjusts to a life they never expected.Chris Johnson’s ALS diagnosis and rapid health changesJohnson first noticed that something was wrong when his right hand became weaker and his grip did not feel normal. After testing, doctors diagnosed him with sporadic ALS in May 2025. He later told ABC’s Good Morning America that he wanted to share his story because it could help another person get diagnosed sooner, support research or give another family hope.In his September 2026 interview with Sports Illustrated, Johnson said he can no longer speak, walk without major help or keep his head fully upright. A tablet controlled by his eyes now allows him to communicate, while a CPAP machine helps with breathing. His family helps with feeding, changing and stretching.Johnson has also wondered whether his years in football had anything to do with his illness. However, he has said doctors have not told him that football caused his ALS or given him a clear reason for why he developed it. His doctors consider his case sporadic, meaning there is no known family history.Chris Johnson’s family, football legacy and fight for more timeBrittany Johnson has stayed beside her husband throughout the illness and now provides much of his daily care. In a recent People interview, she described the work as constant, while Chris said ALS has affected everyone around him. Their four children have become a major source of strength as the family deals with each new change.That focus on family is at the heart of Johnson’s message. In his Sports Illustrated interview, he spoke about wanting to see his daughter Honey grow up, watch his twin sons reach their goals and see his older son Lee become a doctor. He also wants more years with Brittany. “At the end of the day, I just want more time with the people I love,” Johnson told Sports Illustrated.That hope now sits beside a career built around speed and strength. The Tennessee Titans drafted Johnson in 2008, and he became one of the NFL’s stars. In 2009, he rushed for 2,006 yards, earned NFL Offensive Player of the Year honors and set the still-standing single-season record of 2,509 yards from scrimmage. His career ended with 9,651 rushing yards.The Titans had planned to induct Johnson into their Ring of Honor on September 13, 2026, but postponed the ceremony after he and his family could not travel to Nashville. The team held a halftime tribute.For Johnson, the story now goes far beyond football records. “ALS has changed what my body can do, but it hasn’t changed who I am,” he said on Good Morning America.Stay updated with the latest Asian Games 2026 news, check the Asian Games medal tally and complete Asian Games schedule.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Jaxson Dart tore his MCL and meniscus which require surgery and ends his 2026 season with the New York Giants
articles.summary: Jaxson Dart faces MCL and meniscus surgery that will sideline the New York Giants quarterback for six to nine months, derailing the team's season.
articles.body: Jaxson Dart is headed to knee surgery and that will end his chances of playing again during the 2026 NFL season. Multiple reports say, and OutKick has confirmed, that Dart suffered not only MCL damage but also meniscus damage when he took a vicious hit early in the Monday Night Football game against the Los Angeles Rams. Dart also sprained his PCL, but the torn MCL and torn meniscus are the major problems that must be addressed by surgery. The only good news in this entire scenario is that Dart did not sustain any damage to his ACL. It is intact, a source said. Dart and the Giants spent the past day or so seeking multiple medical opinions in search of options that might keep him from missing the entire rest of the season. Ultimately, because surgery is needed, the other options were eliminated. Bottom line? Dart's timeline for returning to play following surgery to repair the MCL and meniscus is approximately six to nine months. What does all this mean? The New York Giants season has been derailed. They won't say this. The roster is filled with good players, coach John Harbaugh is among the best in the NFL, and he has a very good staff. But any NFL team that loses its starting quarterback is all but finished for the season. Yes, the Philadelphia Eagles lost starting quarterback Carson Wentz to injury and eventually won the Super Bowl during the 2017-18 season. But Wentz was injured in Week 14. Nick Foles played only three-regular season games and then went on an improbable and outstanding playoff run. THE CRAIG CARTON SHOW–UNFILTERED, UNAPOLOGETIC AND UNMISSABLE. DOWNLOAD HIS DAILY PODCAST NOW! WILL LEVIS TO SIGN WITH NEW YORK JETS PRACTICE SQUAD IN HOPES OF MEETING POTENTIAL UNDER RESPECTED QB COACHES The Giants face the next 15 games without their starting quarterback. They face those 15 regular-season game with Jameis Winston as their starting quarterback. Winston has a 36-53 record in the 89 NFL games he has started. The Giants were 0-2 with him starting in place of Dart last season. The Giants have had internal discussions on finding other quarterback options, according to a league source. But the chances of that conjuring a trade for a starting-caliber star are practically nil. All ugly facts. But facts nonetheless. FOLLOW ARMANDO SALGUERO ON X: @ARMANDOSALGUERO

articles.title: Travis Hunter to Be More 'Involved' in Jaguars Offense After Struggles, HC Liam Coen Says
articles.summary: Travis Hunter could be seeing more usage at wide receiver following the Jacksonville Jaguars' Week 2 loss at the Denver Broncos.
articles.body:
Travis Hunter could be seeing more usage at wide receiver following the Jacksonville Jaguars' Week 2 loss at the Denver Broncos.

Jaguars coach Liam Coen said Wednesday he plans to "look at" giving Hunter more offensive snaps after mainly using him at cornerback so far this season.

"Any time you struggle offensively, specifically, you look at the totality of it all, and Travis is a big part of that," Coen told reporters Wednesday. "We're looking at finding different ways to get him involved. You're also looking at the other side of the ball. I thought he did a nice job throughout the course of the week, and we're going to look at giving him some more this week.

"It is a balancing act, though, right? You're trying to get into a flow, whether it's on offense or defense. But we have corners that we have a lot of confidence in."

Coen concluded, "When you struggle to move the ball specifically in the fourth quarter when we did, and you lose, we've got to go look at it... everything that we're doing, touches, targets, all of that stuff, and he's a part of it."

Hunter has played 58 percent of the Jaguars' defensive snaps and nine percent of the team's offensive snaps through his first two games of the season, during which he has recorded five tackles.

He was targeted once and caught an eight-yard pass during the Jaguars' season-opening win over the Cleveland Browns, during which he was used at wide receiver only in a specialty role, as noted by ESPN's Bill Barnwell.

Hunter came close to an interception on the opening Week 2 drive against the Broncos but took a costly pass interference call later in the loss.

After repeatedly expressing interest in functioning as a two-way player in the lead-up to his rookie season, Hunter was used most on offense during his rookie 2025 campaign before he suffered a season-ending right knee injury ahead of Week 8.

The team seemingly signaled a change in direction this offseason when running Hunter mostly as a cornerback in the final stretch of training camp.

Coen will now need to decide this week if giving Hunter more opportunities on offense is worth potentially re-distributing targets in a wide receiver room currently led by Parker Washington, Brian Thomas Jr. and Jakobi Meyers.

The Jaguars have four days left to adjust before the New England Patriots, and a defense that has allowed just one passing touchdown in two games, come to town Sunday for a 1 p.m. ET kickoff in Jacksonville.

articles.title: Deshaun Watson 'ready for support' of Browns fans during home opener in Week 3
articles.summary: Watson was booed when the Browns last played at home during the preseason.
articles.body:
Deshaun Watson is ready to feel the love from Cleveland Browns fans as the team prepares for its home opener on Sunday against the Carolina Panthers .

The last time the Browns played at Huntington Bank Field was during the preseason. It was a memorable day as fans booed Watson, who later called the response "disrespectful" and "personal" before explaining that his reaction was born out of emotions.

Now, coming off a 23-19 win over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in Week 2, and Watson playing one of his best games in a Browns uniform with 238 passing yards and two touchdowns, the quarterback is ready to deliver more wins.

"I never try to go to war with the fans so the biggest thing is ready for support, ready to feel their energy, ready to get this big dub for the city of Cleveland and continue this great feeling that we have this week," Watson said via 92.3 The Fan . "That's my motto. Keep moving forward, finding ways to win on Sunday and take advantage of the opposing team and get a W."

Watson did not want to revisit the reception he received during that preseason game against the Buffalo Bills . He said he's looking forward and hoping to build off last week's victory.

"We've passed that," Watson said. "That's back in the day. I don't want to backtrack on anything. We're moving forward, there's great energy now, there's great energy this week within the locker room, within this city, so let's continue to build on that. That's in the past, so let's push forward. We're present in the moment now. We're focusing on Carolina, coming home against a good opponent in front of our great fans. We wanted that energy so we can go in there and get a W."

The Browns will be right back to it following Sunday's game against the Panthers. They will host the Pittsburgh Steelers on Thursday night before getting a few extra days of rest ahead of visiting the New York Jets in Week 5. Whether Watson remains the quarterback over the next few weeks will be determined by his play, especially with Shedeur Sanders waiting to get another opportunity under center.

articles.title: Antonio Brown’s attempted murder case takes unexpected turn as former NFL star prepares to accept a surprising plea deal
articles.summary: Antonio Brown is set to accept a plea deal in his Miami-Dade attempted murder case that would keep him out of prison.
articles.body: Antonio Brown is set to accept a plea deal in his Miami-Dade attempted murder case that would keep him out of prison. Brown’s lawyer, Mark Eiglarsh, told TMZ Sports that prosecutors have offered a deal that would sharply reduce the second-degree attempted murder charge and lead to probation instead of prison. Brown is expected to appear in court on September 30, when the agreement is expected to be formally presented to the judge.Antonio Brown’s plea deal would reduce the attempted murder chargeThe deal is a major change from where the case stood when Brown was first charged. Prosecutors had accused the former NFL wide receiver of second-degree attempted murder after a May 2025 shooting connected to an altercation at a boxing event in Miami. Because a firearm was involved, Brown faced a possible 20-year mandatory minimum sentence and could have received up to 30 years if convicted. The Miami Police Department confirmed that an arrest warrant for Brown was issued on an attempted murder charge after its investigation into the shooting.According to TMZ Sports, Brown’s lawyer said the new agreement would reduce the charge and give Brown probation rather than prison time. The exact reduced charge and full terms of the agreement have not been made public yet, so those details are expected to become clearer in court next week.“This was not an easy decision,” Eiglarsh told TMZ Sports.He also said Brown still believes he is innocent and believes his Stand Your Ground defense would have allowed him to win at trial. Eiglarsh said the decision came after prosecutors offered a resolution that would replace the possibility of decades in prison with a reduced charge and probation.That means the plea deal does not represent Brown admitting to the original attempted murder allegation. The agreement still needs to be formally handled in court before its final terms take effect.Antonio Brown case began after May 2025 Miami shootingThe case goes back to May 16, 2025, when Brown was involved in a confrontation with Zul-Qarnain Kwame Nantambu outside an underground boxing event in Miami’s Little Haiti area. Authorities said the argument became physical before a gun was fired during the incident. Brown has maintained that he was protecting himself and his lawyer has pointed to Florida’s Stand Your Ground law as part of his defense.An arrest warrant was issued for Brown in June 2025 while he was in Dubai. U.S. Marshals later took him into custody overseas, and he was eventually returned to Florida. Brown pleaded not guilty after his return and was released on bond with house arrest conditions.The case took another turn earlier this month when Nantambu said he no longer wanted to participate in the prosecution. His lawyer, Richard L. Cooper, said Nantambu had forgiven Brown but stressed that this did not change the seriousness of what happened. The decision did not automatically end the case because prosecutors still had control over whether to continue it.Now, Brown’s next major step is the September 30 Miami-Dade court hearing. articles.title: Patriots place safety Dell Pettus on injured reserve, promote edge rusher to 53-man roster
articles.summary: Outside linebacker Jose Ramirez has taken the open spot.
articles.body:
The New England Patriots will be without Dell Pettus for a minimum of four games.

The organization sent the safety to injured reserve on Wednesday morning, as head coach Mike Vrabel announced during his press conference , and promoted outside linebacker Jose Ramirez to the 53-man roster in a corresponding move.

Pettus, 25, suffered an ankle injury on special teams in the second quarter of last weekend's 20-3 win over the Pittsburgh Steelers . He was downgraded from questionable to out along with fellow safety Craig Woodson by the end of the home opener at Gillette Stadium.

Signed as an undrafted free agent in 2024, Pettus made the initial active roster in Foxborough as a rookie and has appeared in all 36 games since then as well as Super Bowl LX. Making a pair of starts in the secondary, the 5-foot-11, 200-pound Troy alum stands with 471 snaps on defense and 579 snaps on special teams in his NFL career. He has notched 56 tackles, two sacks, one forced fumble and one first down as the personal punt protector.

A September signing will take the open spot for New England .

Ramirez, 27, joined the 17-man practice squad in the days following the league's cutdown deadline and gets the call-up on the heels of recent Dre'Mont Jones and Quintayvious Hutchins ailments off the edges. Entering the NFL in the sixth round of the 2023 draft at No. 196 overall, the former MAC Defensive Player of the Year by way of Arizona , Riverside City College and Eastern Michigan has appeared in four career games.

After setting out with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers , with whom he saw 30 snaps on defense and 40 snaps on special teams, Ramirez spent last year with the CFL's Hamilton Tiger-Cats before circling back to the NFL. The 6-foot-2, 252-pound outside linebacker signed a futures contract with the Philadelphia Eagles in January and was waived at the conclusion of training camp.

"Been a really good practice player for us," Vrabel said of promoting Ramirez. "I think he's improved since the time he's been here, multiple times being recognized. He's taken the reps that we talk about being on the show team and using those to his advantage. So, whether they'll be an opportunity, we'll see, for him to be able to help us this week when we get down to the 48-man roster."

The Jacksonville Jaguars host next Sunday's 1 p.m. ET kickoff at EverBank Stadium.

articles.title: After Jaxson Dart helped seal Giants recruitment of John Harbaugh, coach now faces bleak debut season
articles.summary: The Giants have a chance to settle their offense and keep their season floor afloat. Their ceiling, meanwhile, faces serious doubt.
articles.body:
All offseason, New York Giants head coaches had hammered home the message to their quarterback: Protect yourself.

The Giants loved 2025 first-round pick Jaxson Dart 's toughness, and they built an offense with plays designed to exploit the math problem his mobility creates for defenses.

No one told Dart not to run. But coaches and front-office members alike kept reminding Dart through spring and summer to slide at run's end. They reminded him to protect himself rather than lay his body on the line at comparatively inconsequential moments, as he had during his rookie year.

"You can't just say, 'Don't run the football here because you could get hurt' — you have to show him evidence," offensive coordinator Matt Nagy told Yahoo Sports in June. "Where did you take the extra hits? Was it necessary?

And then a cruel irony unfolded: In the second game of Dart's sophomore season, as he demonstrated the development of a passer cycling through his progressions, he suffered a season-ending injury anyway .

Sometimes, the violent game of football doesn't care.

Dart wasn't scrambling Monday night when, on the seventh snap of the game, he was crushed awkwardly. He wasn't even escaping the pocket to throw on the run.

Dart was dropping back, and winding up for a well-placed throw to tight end Theo Johnson on third-and-8, when edge rusher Byron Young swarmed from his left side and outside linebacker Josaiah Stewart closed in from Dart's right. As Young moved in for the tackle, Dart fell into Stewart.

Dart lay on the ground, clutching his left knee, before eventually limping off without the help of staff or a cart. He even returned to the sideline in a gray hoodie and black turtleneck after initial tests indicated that no, his requests to return that night would not be granted, but there was at least optimism about the duration and severity of his injury.

A Tuesday MRI proved more daunting, the specter of season-ending surgery suddenly looming over the Giants and their quarterback. By Wednesday, per multiple reports, the decision was made: Dart will undergo surgery to repair damage to his meniscus, MCL and PCL. His ACL is intact.

Head coach John Harbaugh, whose appreciation for Dart strongly swayed his decision to join the Giants in January, is left to pick up the pieces of an offense now in the hands of Jameis Winston .

How much does a head coach's job change when his starting quarterback goes down?

"I think that's a pretty self-evident answer, isn't it?" Harbaugh told reporters Tuesday over Zoom, declining to confirm the severity or rehabilitation timeline of Dart's injury. "It's an important position, obviously. That's a pretty obvious answer.

"Just theoretically. I mean we're talking theory, I take it."

A key reason Harbaugh took Giants job: Jaxson Dart

After the Baltimore Ravens fired Harbaugh in January after 18 seasons, the landscape of a favorable market emerged. In a rare year, 10 NFL teams moved on from their coaches after the 2025 NFL season.

Harbaugh was the most attractive candidate by many metrics. He would have his choice among several suitors.

So Harbaugh wasn't going to team up with just any quarterback after enjoying success with two-time MVP Lamar Jackson . The Giants knew they needed to sell Harbaugh on their potential.

"We were trying to recruit him to come on a coaching visit," Giants general manager Joe Schoen told Yahoo Sports in June. "He had whoever his army of people were watching the offense, watching the defense, schematically. Also watching the individual talents. We didn't play Baltimore last year, so I'm not sure he realized how well Jaxson played throughout the season.

"I would say he was pleasantly surprised."

Harbaugh met with Dart in person for about 45 minutes during his interview process, Schoen said. The two watched film together, discussing both scheme and culture.

"I think I learned just how charismatic [Dart] is and how much he really wants to win," Harbaugh told Yahoo Sports of the meeting. "I also learned how dialed into what it takes [he is]. He was asking me some really, really good questions about how we're going to run things and I could just tell we're going to think alike. …

Harbaugh now needs to do what his job takes without his most important player.

Dart finished his rookie year completing 63.7% of his passes for 2,272 yards, 15 touchdowns and 5 interceptions. He rushed for an additional 487 yards and nine scores, across his 14 total games that included 12 starts.

In a season-opening win against the Cowboys, Dart completed 79.3% of his pass attempts for 230 yards and three touchdowns while rushing 11 more times for 54 yards. The Giants did not turn over the ball in the 28-20 win.

Dart, whom coaches believed finished his rookie year with underrated anticipatory throwing, said he felt comfortable. Nagy praised his quarterback for his calm and composure making plays. Dart's 134.2 passer rating, albeit in one game, marked the most efficient game of his career by 24 points. Dart exploited Cowboys' weaknesses well, at one point targeting the left flat three times on the same series when he discerned the Giants' favorable leverage.

The Rams' defense would prove stiffer in a Week 2 "Monday Night Football" game, but Giants brass traveled to Los Angeles excited to see Dart rise to the occasion.

Instead, after five pass attempts in the first series, Dart was limping off. And while Winston was serviceable last season in two-and-a-half games of play, throwing for three touchdowns while scoring another two via rushing and receiving, he completed just 11 of 27 pass attempts (40.7%) for 111 yards, no scores and an interception in what became a 28-6 loss on Monday.

Harbaugh defended Winston, saying the team as a whole "didn't play up to that level across the board." A day after the loss, the coach continued to express faith in his quarterback.

"Absolute faith in all of our players," Harbaugh said. "That's why all the guys are here. Jameis is one of our guys who obviously is here for a reason. He's a very good football player."

Harbaugh: 'If you get punched in the gut, are you going down?'

There's reason to believe Winston's 2026 season could unfold better than his initial start.

While Winston's career has been characterized with entertaining highs and mind-boggling lows, there's reason to believe he can improve from his first outing.

To start: Any quarterback receiving first-team snaps throughout the week will be better prepared to navigate an opponent than a quarterback thrust into game action. Winston's difficulty transitioning could also reflect how different his play style is from that of Dart, for whom the Giants game plan vs. the Rams was designed. The Giants also struggled to run the ball against the Rams, mustering just 52 yards off 21 carries (2.5 yards per carry).

So while the Giants will look to tweak Winston's decision-making, precision and patience on certain plays, expect them also to prepare a game plan less reliant on a quarterback's dual-threat abilities than their plan last week. (In comparison, when Marcus Mariota replaced Washington Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels against the Dallas Cowboys last weekend, Mariota's mobility translated better to zone-read principles on which Daniels thrives.)

Another reason for short-term encouragement about the Giants' chances to win without Dart: their schedule. Three of the Giants' next five opponents are currently 0-2, beginning with the Tennessee Titans who visit Sunday on the Giants' short week.

The other two are the Arizona Cardinals and New Orleans Saints , who have each split their first two contests.

The Giants have a chance to settle their offense and keep their season floor afloat.

Their ceiling, meanwhile, faces serious doubt.

There's no question that Dart was the emotional and schematic leader of his offense and his team after his breakout rookie year and unique array of skills energized a franchise that has won just one playoff game since their Super Bowl campaign in the 2011 season.

The Giants have earned a playoff berth only once in their last nine tries. Their chance of a postseason run this season has taken a serious hit. ESPN's Football Power Index pitted the Giants' chances to make the playoffs at 43% after their Week 1 win vs. the Cowboys, only to plummet that chance to 1% after Dart's injury paired with a Week 2 loss.

Harbaugh emphasized the Giants' need to keep fighting.

"A gut punch — I mean, how many people face gut punches every single day?" Harbaugh asked.

"If you get punched in the gut, are you going down? Are you going down? Are you going to crumple to the ground, as Jack Harbaugh would say, like a sack of sour apples and just fall to the ground and just rot away and wither away into the dust. Is that what you're going to do?

images.caption: Jaxson Dart will watch the rest of the Giants' season on the sideline due to a knee injury. (Harry How via Getty Images)

articles.title: Giants have various possible options at quarterback (but not many good ones)
articles.summary: With Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart reportedly heading for season-ending knee surgery, the Giants have to make a decision about the quarterback position movi...
articles.body:
With Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart reportedly heading for season-ending knee surgery, the Giants have to make a decision about the quarterback position moving forward.

Option A: The Jameis Winston experience, and everything that goes along with it — good, bad, and/or highly entertaining.

Option B: Sign a free agent and see if he would be a better option to win games. At this point, however, most guys who are available would be unlikely to be able to start. Jimmy Garoppolo is the best option.

There are some options. Here are some of the ones we noticed after perusing the various rosters and depth charts.

Derek Carr : He's still on the Saints reserve-retired list. A trade would be required, if there's mutual interest.

Anthony Richardson: If the Colts would be comfortable with Riley Leonard as the understudy to Daniel Jones , the Colts could finally get value for the fourth overall pick in the 2023 draft.

Joe Flacco : John Harbaugh won a Super Bowl with Flacco in Baltimore . And Flacco has repeatedly shown he can still play.

Shedeur Sanders : If the Browns are willing to move on from Sanders, Harbaugh possibly would want Shedeur. The Ravens were going to draft him in 2025, but he didn't want to back up Lamar Jackson .

Mason Rudolph : He has played a lot, and he may not have much of a future in Pittsburgh .

Sam Howell : He's the backup to Dak Prescott , and he has plenty of starting experience; the Cowboys could elevate Joe Milton III to take Prescott's place.

J.J. McCarthy : Jim Harbaugh loves him. John Harbaugh could be intrigued by him.

Gardner Minshew : If the Cardinals are content to have Carson Beck as the backup to Jacoby Brissett , why not? He has 47 career starts.

Mac Jones : He's in the last year of his contract, and he played well last year in place of Brock Purdy .

The Giants also could pilfer a player from a practice squad. Possibilities (not many) include Will Levis (Jets), Josh Johnson (Bengals), Joe Milton III (Cowboys), and Max Brosmer (Vikings).
